newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle up $2.00-$3.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle up $2.00-$3.00 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were $2.00-$3.00 per cwt higher, compared to last week's close, USDA said.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 58.00-66.00, including 19 head black/black-whiteface 669 lbs 66.00; 700-800 lbs 58.00-62.50; 25 head black/black-whiteface 809 lbs 66.90. Holsteins - Large 2 600-700 lbs 42.00-44.00; 31 head 845 lbs 47.80.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 55.00-58.75, including 28 head black/black-whiteface 691 lbs 58.75; 700- 800 lbs few 55.00-55.25. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 1,198
